snippet.title: Thats An Order Ensign Trailer
snippet.description:
As a new recruit you've got a lot of tasks to complete - from the mundane to the deathly dangerous and everything in between. Perform admirably, and quickly, or you may be walking the proverbial (possibly literal) plank!
